dedupe_keys.name: maranello road crash records and statistics 20242025

description: Comune di Maranello publishes 41 complementary listings of local-police road-crash records and statistical views for 2024 and 2025. The core event-table schema names incident date/time, road/locality, coordinates, road and surface characteristics, weather/traffic conditions, vehicle categories, injuries/fatalities, violations and patrol timing. Other source titles identify summaries by location, month, weekday, intersection, incident type, severity, vehicles and people. Selected injury-table schemas explicitly connect incidents with people and injury outcomes. Schema detail varies by table and is not projected onto every component. Tables can represent the same events through different dimensions or exports, and annual versions may overlap. They must not be summed as independent incidents. The named municipality is the publisher and source-labelled scope; per-row location/coverage and populated fields were not inspected. Generic alcohol/drug-control summaries remain outside this group pending evidence of their road-system role. Coverage is Maranello, Italy. The source declares the CC BY 4.0 licence and CSV access links. Metadata are public; later file-use costs and completeness remain unknown. No specific simulation application is documented. Related tables are grouped by the named publisher, police/incident subject and stated period; unrelated municipal datasets are not included. One additional 2024 view, Comune di Maranello - Analisi combinata 2024, is linked to the same publisher and incident series. Its exact schema declares Natura Incidente, Totale. This is an overlapping statistical view, not a new set of independent events.

Other component schemas can differ.
